build_pointnet_backbone: build a PointNet backbone network for point cloud feature learning with configurable scale and MLP head
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a point cloud tensor through the PointNet network to extract features
create_set_abstraction_layers: create four set abstraction layers with PointnetSAModuleVotes for hierarchical point cloud downsampling
create_feature_upsampling_layers: create two feature upsampling layers using PointnetFPModule to interpolate features back to seed points
review_break_up_pc: review the _break_up_pc method that splits a point cloud tensor into xyz coordinates and feature channels
